mapper.select: SELECT f.feed_id, f.feed_img_url, COUNT(l.like_id) AS likeCount, false AS isLikedByUser FROM feed_tb f LEFT JOIN like_tb l ON f.feed_id = l.feed_id WHERE f.create_dt BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND f.feed_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY f.feed_id, f.feed_img_url ORDER BY likeCount DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT f.feed_id, f.user_id, f.feed_img_url, f.feed_location, u.nickname, u.profile_img_url, COUNT(l.like_id) AS likeCount
, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM like_tb li WHERE li.feed_id = f.feed_id AND li.user_id = #{loginUserId}) > 0 AS isLikedByUser
, false AS isLikedByUser
FROM feed_tb f LEFT JOIN user_tb u ON f.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN like_tb l ON f.feed_id = l.feed_id WHERE f.feed_id = #{feedId} GROUP BY f.feed_id, f.user_id, f.feed_img_url, f.feed_location, u.nickname, u.profile_img_url
SELECT feed_id, feed_img_url, feed_longitude, feed_latitude FROM feed_tb WHERE create_dt BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feed_tb ( feed_id, user_id, feed_img_url, feed_status, feed_location, feed_longitude, feed_latitude, create_dt, update_dt ) VALUES ( 0, #{userId}, #{feedImgUrl}, 'ACTIVE', #{feedLocation}, #{feedLongitude}, #{feedLatitude}, now(), now() )
